data.name: Brigit
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Celtic word ‘brig’, meaning ‘power’ or ‘exalted one’. Brigit was an ancient Celtic goddess of poetry, healing, and fertility. In Christian tradition, Saint Brigit is revered as a patron saint of poetry, healing, and smiths. She is also known for her kindness, generosity, and miracles.
data.numerology_meaning: Nurturing, loving, and caring. A natural healer and nurturer. Creative and artistic.

in_hebrew.name: בריגית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם בריגית מקורו בלטינית ומשמעותו 'נשרה אלוהים' או 'כוח אלוהי'. השם נגזר מהמילה הלטינית 'brigantia', שפירושה 'נשרה' או 'אלגנטית'. השם בריגית משוייך לנוצרים ומשקף את האמונה בנישואים אלוהיים.

in_greek.name: Μπρίγκιτ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μπρίγκιτ προέρχεται από τη λατινική λέξη 'brigantia', που σημαίνει 'υψηλή' ή 'ανώτατη'. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα Μπρίγκιτ συνδέεται με την έννοια της θεοδυναμένης κορυφής ή της ανώτατης πνευματικής κατάστασης. Το όνομα αυτό αντανακλά την πνευματική και θρησκευτική σημασία του στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας.

in_latin.name: Brigit
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Brigit originem habet in lingua latina, ubi 'brigantia' dicitur, quod 'eximia' seu 'summa virtus' significat. In traditione christiana, nomen Brigit exprimit ideam virtutis divinae seu potestatis caelestis. Hoc nomen habet significationem profundam spiritualem et vim symbolicam.

in_english.name: Brigit
in_english.long_meaning: The name Brigit originates from Latin 'brigantia', meaning 'exalted one' or 'divine strength'. It is associated with Christian tradition and reflects a connection to spiritual elevation and divine power. Historically, the name Brigit has been used in various Christian cultures, symbolizing a strong spiritual presence and a deep sense of faith.

saint_reference.note: Irish saint known for her piety and devotion to God.

data.cultural_impact: Saint Brigit played a significant role in early Christian communities in Ireland, particularly among the Celts. Her worship was assimilated into Christian practice, and she became associated with symbols of light, fire, and fraternity. The Ninth Century foundation of Kildare Abbey, named after Brigit’s well where a perpetual fire was kept burning, solidified her place in Irish religious and cultural heritage. Still to this day, she is celebrated as a symbol of Irish national identity and cultural continuity.
data.spiritual_significance: Brigit’s legacy is one of prayer, meditation, and spiritual inspiration. Her welcome and generosity to all people, regardless of social status or background, has been a powerful inspiration for Christians seeking peace and harmony in their lives. Additionally, the use of fire in her symbolism represents the transformative power of the Holy Spirit in our lives. Her patronage of poetry and the arts reflects the importance of creativity in our spiritual journeys. Overall, her spiritual significance lies in her ability to inspire us through her story to be kind, generous, and supportive to others while connecting with the divine within.

historical_references.reference: Brigit of Kildare was a 5th-century Irish saint, known as a healer and a goddess of poetry, fertility, and the arts.

trends: Brigit is a popular name for girls in Ireland, and is also used in other countries.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Brigit remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Grace Brigit from Rome, Italy embodies the meaning of Brigit - "Bright, Exalted One". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Brigit, an ancient Celtic goddess of fire, fertility, and poetry, is believed to have merged with the Christian saint of the same name. Her symbol is the cross in the form of a flame, representing the divine spark that ignites creativity and new life within us.

seo.title: Saint Brigit - Celtic Goddess turned Christian Saint | Name Meaning & Origin
seo.meta_description: Discover the meaning and origin of the name Brigit. Learn about the ancient Celtic goddess, her Christian sainthood, and her significance in Irish culture.
seo.description_paragraph: Saint Brigit, also known as Bride or Brighid, is a renowned Irish figure rooted in both ancient Celtic religion and Christian tradition. Originating as a goddess of poetry, healing, and fertility in the Celtic pantheon, Brigit later became a revered Christian saint, patron of poetry, healing, and smiths. Known for her generosity, kindness, and miracles, Brigit’s legend continues to inspire and captivate.
